name: HOOK
thought: Starved again. Fruit tastes like dirt.

wants.item: a better branch to hang from
A sturdier branch for tail hangs
a higher perch for tail flips
a branch that can hold my tail loop
a branch that can hold my full weight

diary.line: Did a quiet lap of the spot. Nobody clapped. Rude.
I swung onto the branch, looped the tail and hung like a pro. No applause, but the view's decent.
I rigged a new branch onto the tree, solid enough for a tail hang. No applause, but the view's better.
Chewed on fruit stump. Crunchy but tasteless. Need espresso to feel alive.
